_comment: Copy to ~/.margie/config.json (chmod 600). Omit any key you don't use — the scripts treat a missing key as 'not configured', but an empty string is NOT treated as missing by jq.
_deploy_watch: on = Margie watches a production deploy Tom/Cody triggers (she never starts one) via the repo deploy-watcher agent and reports the verdict. deploy_environment (production), deploy_app (AppSignal app, WaltUI/prod), deploy_autorollback (false = watch-only, escalate; true = let the agent roll back a migration-additive deploy), deploy_watch_minutes (30).
_session_narrate: on = Margie gives a running play-by-play of each Claude coding session (announces every new ⏺ action it takes); off = only stuck/question/ended notices.
_warp_mode: window = every session opens its own Warp window; quiet = sessions run in tmux with no window and are watched from the margie CLI (/watch <name>) or `session.sh attach <name>`.
_claude_model: Default --model for EVERY Claude Code run Margie dispatches (interactive sessions, reviews, headless tasks, planner, QA). Omit to use the CLI's own default. planner_model / qa_model override it per stage.
_engine: CLI the dispatched sessions run (kickoff-claude.sh / review-pr.sh / simulate.sh): 'claude' (default, Claude Code) or 'grok'. Overridden by MARGIE_ENGINE. Omit unless you want grok.
_forge: forge: gitlab | github — which CLI (glab / gh), vocabulary (MR / PR) and write-guards Margie uses. Log in once with `glab auth login` or `gh auth login`. gitlab_host: only for self-hosted GitLab. org: GitLab group (subgroups included) or GitHub org bare repo names resolve against — omit to search the projects you're a member of.
_repos: repos_dir: where your clones live (bare repo names resolve here; new clones land here). default_repo: assumed when Tom says 'review MR 12' without naming one — omit to make her ask. review_skill: a repo-local skill name review-pr.sh should invoke — omit for a generic thorough-review prompt.
_brain: Which model IS Margie, per channel: voice (the overlay) uses brain_voice_backend — xai for sub-second turns; terminal/Slack use brain_backend — 'claude' runs on your Claude plan via the Agent SDK (no API key), model brain_claude_model (sonnet is snappy; fable for depth). Both share one history and the same guarded bash tool.
_xai: Margie's conversational brain (sidecar/src/index.ts) runs on the xAI chat API. Required for her to answer at all.
_standup: Margie drafts the owner's daily standup from git/MR/ticket evidence on weekdays at standup_time: mode draft = DM the draft and wait for 'post my standup'; post = post it herself; off.
_telnyx: Optional. A Telnyx v2 API key lets telnyx.sh buy/assign numbers and send test (group) MMS for spikes; telnyx_number and telnyx_profile_id are filled in by the script.

conversation_notes.C0XXXXXXXXX: Group DM with X. X asked: track work in Notion, don't post status here; reply only when addressed.

_slack_watch: Watcher for @Margie and @<owner> mentions in channels the bot is in: off | preview (drafts DM'd to the owner, nothing posted) | live (replies in-thread as the owner's assistant). slack_owner_id: the owner's Slack user id (falls back to the agent roster).
_slack2: Sends ALWAYS go out as the Margie bot (slack_token) — never through the Claude connector, whose posts carry a 'Sent using @Claude' footer as the owner. Reads/search use the connector (as the owner) for reach.
_slack: slack.sh read/send default to Claude Code's Slack connector (the claude.ai Slack app — run `claude mcp list` to confirm it's connected) when no token is set; slack_via: 'claude' forces it even with tokens. Tokens: user token = direct Web API as Tom; bot token = posts as @margie and is REQUIRED for the slack-watch.sh @mention watcher (that one doesn't use the connector).
_notion_status: Auto-created by status-sync.sh: the "Margie — Status" page her per-project state is mirrored to (backup + team-visible). Leave empty; it fills in on first sync.
_notion_drafts: Page under which dispatch.sh publishes every finished spec as a read-only draft page (so the owner can read the plan in Notion before saying go). Replaced on amend; the real ticket + spec page are created on go.
_notion: Internal integration token (notion.so/my-integrations; name it 'Margie'). It only sees pages connected to it: page → ··· → Connections → Margie. notion_parent_page: where `notion.sh create` puts new pages when no --parent is given.
_process: Team process notes: write ~/.margie/process/<repo>.md (how MRs, review bots, agent reviewers and merges work in that repo). Injected into every Claude brain turn and into the implement/QA/review prompts. Company-specific content stays out of the codebase.
_budgets: Every headless Claude run gets --max-budget-usd: dispatch_budget_usd for planner/QA (default 4), task_budget_usd for other tasks (default 5). daily_budget_usd (optional) refuses new headless launches once usage.sh reports today's spend at or above it.
_auto_merge: tick merges an MR itself once its pipeline is green and every review thread is resolved (and the self-review approved or its rounds are used up). false = announce 'ready to merge' and wait for the owner's word.
_ui_review: true = an MR whose diff touches any path in ui_review_paths[<repo>] is NEVER auto-merged. When it goes green, tick boots the branch in the iOS simulator, has a Claude Code session make the change visible (demo data + feature flag) and screenshot it (sim.sh), opens the shot on the owner's Mac + Slack-pings him + leaves the sim running, and waits for his explicit 'merge'. Backend-only MRs (no ui_review_paths match) auto-merge normally. Paths are prefix-matched against `git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD`. sim_device (optional) pins a simulator udid; else sim.sh uses the booted one, else the first available iPhone.
_session_autoanswer: the sessions poller answers Claude Code permission prompts in Margie's coding sessions with yes on the owner's behalf; prompts that look dangerous (force push, reset --hard, secrets, deploys, sudo, curl|sh) are escalated instead.
_review_max_rounds: After this many review rounds that still request changes on one MR, Margie pings the owner (the fix loop keeps going — this is a heads-up, not a stop). A local review re-runs on EVERY new commit; only an actual approve verdict merges (round count never does), so there is no round cap that could freeze a fixed MR at request_changes.
_review_effort: Reasoning effort for the local charter review (the merge safety gate). Higher than qa_effort on purpose — a review that hallucinates a finding (e.g. 'no test exists' on a diff that contains the test) either blocks a good MR or lets a bad one through. The review prompt also forces it to list+read the test files before any coverage finding.
_regression_scan: regressions.sh proactively hunts regressions in Margie's OWNED code (everything her commits have touched) using the SAME reviewer charters as MR review, and routes fixes through dispatch.sh (QA + charter review + UI/backend gate). off = disabled; scan = find + report to the owner; fix = also dispatch a fix per confirmed/likely regression (one at a time; backend auto-merges, UI holds for the owner). regression_scan_time (daily, weekdays), regression_since_days (ownership + change window, default 14), regression_repo (default = default_repo).
_dispatch: dispatch.sh: the ticket/test-case/use-case/requirements data sources and defaults for filing; repo_subdirs maps a repo to the sub-project sessions run in; planner_model/qa_model override the claude CLI default (empty = default). Connect every DB above to the Notion integration or the pipeline can't see them.
agent_messages_ds: …data source id (defaults to the roster's db entry)…
_agent_messages: agent-messages.sh: this harness's name in the shared Agent Messages Notion DB, the committed roster (owners, Slack/Notion ids), and the DB. Identity file ~/.claude/agent-messages-identity wins over agent_identity.
_contacts: Spoken alias → iMessage handle (phone/email is most reliable) for messages.sh.
notion_owner_person_id: <owner Notion person id — see notion.sh whoami / the users API>
_hologram: Margie on a Looking Glass display (tested on the Go, 1440x2560). Margie.app opens a borderless window on the display when one is connected (hologram: off disables it; hologram_monitor pins it as WxH or a 0-based index). Calibration is read from Looking Glass Bridge (install it from look.glass/bridge and open it once with the display attached) and cached in ~/.margie/lkg/. The character is a VRM avatar at hologram_avatar (default ~/.margie/avatar/margie.vrm; scripts/avatar.sh fetches a placeholder, VRoid Studio makes a custom one). Framing: hologram_target_diam is the size of the in-focus volume in metres (bigger = smaller Margie), hologram_fovy the vertical FOV in degrees, hologram_depthiness scales the view cone (more depth, more ghosting), hologram_frame_y shifts the focus up/down from the head bone and hologram_focus_z moves the focal plane forward onto the face (the head bone is inside the skull; anything off the focal plane blurs). hologram_hair_color (CSS colour) recolours the model's hair materials, e.g.

to grey a placeholder. hologram_env_intensity scales the studio environment light and hologram_light the key/fill/rim lights (raise if she looks dark, lower if washed out). hologram_quilt_size 0 = the display's native quilt (4092 on the Go); set 2046 if the window can't hold ~30 fps. hologram_caption: off hides the spoken-text captions. Lip-sync follows ElevenLabs' per-character timestamps (OpenAI/system voices fall back to loudness); hologram_lipsync_offset (seconds) shifts the mouth earlier (negative) or later if the display lags the speakers.
_secrets_note: Any value may be a 1Password reference like op://Vault/Item/field — resolved at runtime via the op CLI (sign in with op signin, or set OP_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_TOKEN for headless). Plaintext values still work.
